notes.title: Island of the Lost - A brand NEW game!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387000/Island_of_the_Lost/]STORE PAGE LINK[/url]
[previewyoutube=gBLp-LtVUgw;full][/previewyoutube]

In the midst of a storm you are marooned on an uncharted island. Journey through eight unique environments. Collect treasures, unlock secrets and search for a way off the island.

Unwind and relax as you explore and linger in the colourful surroundings. Investigate tropical islands, dusty canyons, jungle ruins and deadly swamps.

Features

[list]
[*] A relaxing, peaceful, exploration-adventure full of enchanting detail
[*] Search for hidden treasures and special items, spread across all eight levels
[*] Discover dozens of secret areas and Easter eggs
[*] Watch out for hidden dangers and booby traps!
[*] Steam Achievements to unlock!
[*] Featuring an original score by Emmy-nominated composer Nicholas Singer
[/list]

notes.title: Update/Fixes #04 (18.10.2021)
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the 'Time to leave the Winter Exit' achievement in the 'Winter' level of "Unlocked."

notes.title: Update/Fixes #03 (06.10.2021)
notes.content:
- Following a request, I have enabled players to invert mouse direction if they wish to do so.

By pressing "I" the player can now invert the mouse direction. A reminder of this function is also part of the in-game menu.

- Altered the size of all menu buttons on all game levels.
- Altered the text in all menus from all game levels.

- Fixed an issue with the alignment of text in the Reactor/end cutscene from "Blue Sky on Mars".

notes.title: Update/Fixes #02 (28.09.2021)
notes.content:
- Added a photo mode to allow the player to take clean screenshots without the onscreen UI.

By pressing "P" the player can remove the in-game UI (Unity User Interface/Score Tally) but can then use "PrtScrn" or other screen capture software to take a screen grab. A reminder of this function is now part of the in-game menu.


- Increased the speed/load time/FPS across all levels of the game.

- Re-textured the terrain in 'Spring' level of Unlocked.
- Re-textured the terrain in 'Summer' level of Unlocked.
- Re-textured the terrain in 'Autumn' level of Unlocked.
- Re-textured the terrain in 'Winter' level of Unlocked.

- Re-textured the terrain in the 'Surface' level of Blue Sky on Mars.
- Re-textured the terrain in the 'Canyons' level of Blue Sky on Mars.


- Fixed a terrain break in the 'Summer' level of Unlocked.

- Added/replaced grass elements in the 'Summer' level of Unlocked

- Added new snow particle FX to the 'Winter' level of Unlocked.

- Added a button to the 'Winter' level in-game menu to allow the player to turn on/off the new snow FX.
By pressing "T" the player can remove the new snow particle FX. A reminder of this function is now part of the in-game menu.

notes.title: Update/Fixes #01 (20.06.2021)
notes.content:
- Added forced 'Control' Menus to allow player to see the game controls.

- Added/Replaced Particle FX to Menus.

- Fixed mushroom ramp for easier access on 'Surface' level of Blue Sky on Mars.

- Added cosmetic changes to exit area on 'Surface' level of Blue Sky on Mars.

- Added additional guiding beacons to illustrate player route in the 'Canyons' level of Blue Sky on Mars.

- Altered the gravity player settings on the Space Training levels.
